statement: Authoritative per-component engineering-evidence INVENTORY for Day-11 Part-1. It records, for each representative component, exactly what is datasheet-backed today, what is a schedule/architecture assumption, and what is UNKNOWN. It is NOT a final BOM, NOT a system power/mass total, and does NOT force any final architecture. Representative part classes from results/operational_cost_catalog.json are preserved verbatim (MAX86141, BMI270, TMP117, OPT3001-Q1, ADS1292R, ADS1299-4, AD5940); none are silently replaced. Unknown fields are null or an explicit *_status, never zero.

source_classification_vocabulary.DATASHEET_DIRECT: Value read directly from a manufacturer datasheet at a stated operating condition (e.g. active current in uA).
source_classification_vocabulary.DATASHEET_CALCULATED: Derived from datasheet values by an explicit equation (e.g. P = V x I, per-channel x channels).
source_classification_vocabulary.REFERENCE_SCHEDULE_ASSUMPTION: A sampling/acquisition schedule adopted as an engineering reference (e.g. 'continuous at 100 Hz'); NOT a validated deployable duty cycle.
source_classification_vocabulary.ARCHITECTURE_ASSUMPTION: A structural/topology count adopted as a reference (e.g. colocation => 0 new modules); context-dependent, not a universal claim.
source_classification_vocabulary.MEASURED_IN_PROJECT: Value measured on project hardware. NONE exist yet (no physical build).
source_classification_vocabulary.UNKNOWN: No defensible value yet; recorded as null / explicit status, never zero.

global_notes: SCIENTIFIC SAMPLE RATE != PRODUCT DUTY CYCLE. Dataset acquisition rates (e.g. 100 Hz Sleep-EDF, 500 Hz PTT, 64 Hz PPG-DaLiA, 32 Hz IMU) are experimental acquisition rates, treated here as REFERENCE_SCHEDULE_ASSUMPTION for acquisition, NOT as a frozen forever-on deployable duty cycle.
No MEASURED_IN_PROJECT power or mass exists: there is no physical build. Every active-power figure is DATASHEET_DIRECT or DATASHEET_CALCULATED at a stated condition.

Component-boundary 'average power KNOWN' for ecg_chest / skin_temperature / light_sensor is AFE/IC-only at a REFERENCE_SCHEDULE_ASSUMPTION; it is NOT system average power and excludes MCU/radio/regulator/battery.
Package DIMENSIONS are not package MASS. No component mass is asserted.
